answer_result.answer: Cannot be determined. The evidence says Calvin announced on 2023-10-15 that he got a new Ferrari the previous week (~2023-10-09/15), but it does not clarify that this was his second Ferrari.

question.question: When did Calvin buy his second Ferrari?

evidence_items.text:
Dave: Yeah, Calvin! The crowd had such a buzz. Music brings people together in such an amazing way, and it's just like when I'm fixing up things. I love the feeling of taking something broken and making it whole again. That's why I keep doing what I do.
[S23T11] (dia_id: D23:11)

Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Music and repairing things are so fulfilling and satisfying. Seeing something go from broken to whole is incredible. You're making a difference too - it's amazing. Keep it up, friend.
[S23T12] (dia_id: D23:12)

Dave: Thanks, buddy. Your support really helps. It's great to have a friend who believes in me. I'll keep pushing.
[S23T13] (dia_id: D23:13)

Calvin: I believe in you, Dave. Keep pushing and never forget how awesome you are.
[S23T14] (dia_id: D23:14)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and not forget my value!
[S23T15] (dia_id: D23:15)

Calvin: C'mon, remember how great you are! Keep going for those dreams. You got this! You know what Dave? Last week, I got a new Ferrari! It's a masterpiece on wheels. Excited for thrilling rides and unforgettable journeys! Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood.
[Image caption: a photography of a black sports car parked in front of a building]
[S23T16] (dia_id: D23:16)

Dave: Wow! Thanks a ton for the kind words and encouragement! Your positivity is contagious. Congratulations on the new Ferrari – that's incredible! Must be one amazing ride. I'm all in for those thrilling journeys! Feel free to share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready. Let's keep the good vibes rolling! Take care and see you later!
[S23T17] (dia_id: D23:17)

Calvin: The Ferrari is indeed a showstopper. I'll be sure to share a pic soon. Here's to more thrilling rides and positive vibes. Take care, and looking forward to catching up soon!
[S23T18] (dia_id: D23:18)

- Describes it as "super smooth and real powerful"; getting in is "like an adrenaline rush", and he's "on cloud nine" [S2T3][S2T7].
- Shared a photo from a test ride on 2023-03-25 ("yesterday" as of 2023-03-26) [S2T5].
- Dave asked whether it is his first one and what it's called; Calvin did not give a make or model name in this exchange (later revealed it's a Ferrari on 2023-08-03 — see below) [S2T4].
- On 2023-04-20, shared a photo of the red sports car on display at a show and said he "put a lot of work into it"; Dave agreed it definitely took a lot of work [S3T13][S3T14].
- On 2023-05-03, said long drives in this car really help him relax — "the feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing" and it "helps [him] clear [his] head"; shared a photo of the red sports car driving down a road [S5T8].
- On 2023-08-03, revealed the red luxury sports car is a Ferrari; he just took it for a service and it was "so stressful" — he's pretty attached to it [S12T1].
- On his trip to the Ferrari dealership (mentioned 2023-08-03), saw a lot of amazing cars but says his own is the best and he's "pretty proud" of it — "Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me."; shared a photo of the red car (his Ferrari) lifted on a lift in a garage [S12T7].
- On 2023-08-03, said seeing the car everyday "keeps me motivated and reminds me to keep pushing" [S12T9].
- On 2023-09-22, shared a photo of the red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot — "a sign of my hard work and dedication" — "Looking at it reminds me how far I've come" (shared while comforting Dave over his vintage Mustang engine trouble — details in the Car mod workshop (2023-08-11) section of /memories/dave.md); Dave: "I love the way the sunlight hits this. It's definitely a great symbol of all your hard work. I bet you feel really proud when you look at it." and asked whether Calvin had any special memories with it; Calvin then recalled an amazing drive "one summer day" — "The wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom - it was unforgettable" [S20T2][S20T3][S20T4].
- On 2023-10-08, shared a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom while reacting to Dave's car-show story (shared with "Can't wait to check out your garage") [S22T2].
- On 2023-10-15, announced he got a new Ferrari "last week" (~2023-10-09/15) — "a masterpiece on wheels" — and shared a photo of it (a black sports car parked in front of a building) — "Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood."; he's excited for "thrilling rides and unforgettable journeys." (The car in the photo is black, while the Ferrari he has owned since 2023-03-26 is red — either his new car differs in color or it is a second Ferrari; not clarified.) [S23T16]. Dave congratulated him on it ("Must be one amazing ride") and asked him to "share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready"; Calvin agreed it "is indeed a showstopper" and said he'd "share a pic soon" [S23T17][S23T18].

Calvin: Hey Dave, long time no see! I just took my Ferrari for a service and it was so stressful. I'm kinda attached to it. Can you relate? What kind of hobbies give you a feeling of being restored?
[S12T1] (dia_id: D12:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin, I understand the stress of getting a car serviced. Fixing cars is like therapy for me. Growing up working on cars with my dad, refurbishing them gives me a sense of fulfillment.
[S12T2] (dia_id: D12:2)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! Must feel great to have a hobby that makes you proud. Remember any good memories from working on cars with your dad?
[S12T3] (dia_id: D12:3)

Dave: Yeah, definitely! I have fond memories of working on cars with my dad as a kid. We spent one summer restoring an old car. It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying.
[S12T4] (dia_id: D12:4)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Working together on projects like that really brings people closer. Do you have any pictures from that time?
[S12T5] (dia_id: D12:5)

Dave: Yes, I have one, take a look. It was a wonderful experience.
[Image caption: a photography of a man and a child pose for a picture]
[S12T6] (dia_id: D12:6)

Calvin: Aww, that's cool, Dave. Reminiscing is always fun! That pic you shared takes me back to my trip to the Ferrari dealership. I saw a lot of amazing cars, but as for me, my car is the best and  I'm pretty proud of this. Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me. Take a look at this beauty!
[Image caption: a photography of a red car is lifted on a lift in a garage]
[S12T7] (dia_id: D12:7)

Dave: Your car looks great, Calvin! I can tell why you're proud. Having something like that is motivating. It's like a reminder of what you can achieve.
[S12T8] (dia_id: D12:8)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Seeing it everyday keeps me motivated and reminds me to keep pushing.
[S12T9] (dia_id: D12:9)

Dave: Sounds like you're really motivated, Calvin. What's the biggest goal you're working towards, music-wise or something else?
[S12T10] (dia_id: D12:10)

Calvin: My plan for now is to expand my brand worldwide and grow my fanbase. I want my music to reach more people and make an impact. Working with artists from around the globe and challenging myself to create special music are goals of mine too. Look at the photo of how I performed with the boys last night, they are great at the music!
[Image caption: a photo of a band playing on stage with lights on]
[S12T11] (dia_id: D12:11)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!
[S12T12] (dia_id: D12:12)

- The 2023-10-08 conversation continued: Dave thanked Calvin — "Thanks, Calvin! Means a lot." — and said he's going to keep chasing his dreams and working hard, that conversations like this remind him why he loves what he does [S22T9]; Calvin: "Glad I can remind you, Dave. Keep up the good work and stay focused. You got this!" [S22T10]; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Your support really means a lot. I'll stay focused and keep going. Appreciate the encouragement!" [S22T11]; Calvin: "Yeah Dave! I'll always be here to support you and give you that boost. You're doing great!" [S22T12]; Dave: "Thanks so much, Calvin. Your support means everything to me. I'll keep pushing and reaching for them." [S22T13]; the conversation closed with Calvin: "No worries, Dave. Keep going for it. You got this!" [S22T14].
- On 2023-10-15, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Cal, miss ya!"): told him it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week" — a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal Dave's shop had been trying to secure for months — and that he felt "kinda bummed out" and questioned whether his hard work is a waste ("I put in so much effort at work, but it feels like nothing. Am I wasting my time?") (details in ## Car maintenance shop); Calvin: "Hey Dave, sorry to hear that. It can be discouraging when you feel like your hard work goes unnoticed. But don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it."; Dave: "Calvin, thanks for the encouragement. It can be tough when you feel like your efforts are going unseen. I gotta have faith and patience. I'm sure it's only a matter of time till things work out." and asked how Calvin stays motivated when faced with setbacks; Calvin: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated." (Calvin's motivation details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "That's a great approach, Cal! Reminding yourself of the passion for the goals and getting help from others is really important. Taking a break and having fun sounds so refreshing." and then told Calvin he just got back from a music festival — "it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!" (details in ## Music); Calvin: "Wow Dave, sounds awesome! Music festivals bring so much joy and the energy of the crowd can be amazing." and asked for photos from the festival — "I'd love to check them out and join in on the fun."; Dave shared a photo of the main stage (a photo of a stage with a crowd of people watching a band) — "The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!"; Calvin: "Wow, that looks awesome! The crowd looks really excited and the stage is incredible. Who was the headliner?" — Dave had not answered that question as the chat ended; the conversation then continued (below) and Dave identified The Fireworks as the headliner [S23T1][S23T2][S23T3][S23T4][S23T5][S23T6][S23T7][S23T8].
- The 2023-10-15 conversation continued: Dave said The Fireworks headlined the festival (answering Calvin's question); Calvin: "Wow, I heard great things about The Fireworks! Performing with Frank Ocean recently has been really cool. Seeing them perform live must've been awesome - I bet the energy was electric. That's why I love my job so much - connecting with the crowd." [S23T9][S23T10]. Dave: "The crowd had such a buzz. Music brings people together in such an amazing way, and it's just like when I'm fixing up things. I love the feeling of taking something broken and making it whole again. That's why I keep doing what I do." (echoes his sense of purpose from fixing things — details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) Calvin: "Music and repairing things are so fulfilling and satisfying. Seeing something go from broken to whole is incredible. You're making a difference too - it's amazing. Keep it up, friend." [S23T11][S23T12]. Dave thanked Calvin — his support "really helps," it's "great to have a friend who believes in me," and he'll "keep pushing" [S23T13]; Calvin: "I believe in you, Dave. Keep pushing and never forget how awesome you are." [S23T14]; Dave: "Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and not forget my value!" [S23T15]; Calvin closed urging Dave to "keep going for those dreams. You got this!", then announced he got a new Ferrari "last week" (~2023-10-09/15), sharing a photo of it (a black sports car parked in front of a building) — "Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood." (Calvin's Ferrari details in the New luxury car section of /memories/calvin.md) [S23T16]. The 2023-10-15 conversation then closed: Dave thanked Calvin for the kind words and encouragement ("Your positivity is contagious"), congratulated him on the new Ferrari — "that's incredible! Must be one amazing ride" — and said he was "all in for those thrilling journeys," asking Calvin to "share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready"; Calvin: "The Ferrari is indeed a showstopper. I'll be sure to share a pic soon." — the two are now to keep sharing "thrilling rides and positive vibes," and the chat closed with "Take care, and looking forward to catching up soon!" [S23T17][S23T18].
- On 2023-10-19, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Dave!"): Calvin told him he started touring with Frank Ocean ("Been a few days since we talked, but lots happened") — "it's been amazing" — with so much energy from the crowd and "such a connection when I'm on stage," sharing a photo of his stage performance (a band performing on stage with bright lights); Dave: "Congrats, Calvin! That's awesome. Being able to play your music to a crowd and feel that connection must be unreal. How's the tour going?"; Calvin: "The tour has been great, the energy from the crowd is awesome and jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true."; Dave: "Wow, Calvin! I bet performing with him is like a dream come true! How did it happen?"; Calvin: it all started when they met at a festival in August 2022 ("August last year") and Frank said he wanted to collaborate — "We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible" — sharing a photo of the two on stage (a band performing on stage with a projection of a man on the wall); Dave: "Wow, Calvin - you and Frank are so in tune! It's clear you both rock on stage. Can't wait to catch your show!"; Calvin: "I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows. It's such a great experience, you'll definitely enjoy it!" — sharing a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium ("Look at this crowd, that was insane!"); Dave: "That sounds really exciting! Can't wait to experience it. I'm sure everyone in the crowd is going to be pumped up!" (Calvin's tour details in the Frank Ocean collaboration section of /memories/calvin.md) [S24T1][S24T2][S24T3][S24T4][S24T5][S24T6][S24T7][S24T8].
- The 2023-10-19 conversation continued: Calvin announced he's actually going to Tokyo in November 2023 ("next month") after the tour ends, sharing a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background — "Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like [that]. What a great view!"; Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's great to hear!" and asked any specific spots in Tokyo Calvin is really excited to check out; Calvin: Shibuya Crossing — "like Tokyo's Times Square" — and he's "excited to explore Shinjuku," plus "amazing food there, can't wait to try it again!" — sharing a photo of Shibuya Crossing at night (a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain) — "that's amazing!"; Dave: "Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots! The food in Tokyo is great, I'll have so much fun exploring all the different places." and asked whether Calvin has tried ramen, sharing a photo of a bowl of ramen he tried in Boston (a bowl of soup with broccoli and noodles) — "it was delicious, but I think in Tokyo it will be even better!"; Calvin: never tried it, but "it's supposed to be awesome" — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!"; Dave: "Do it, Calvin! Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!"; the chat closed with Calvin: "Thanks, Dave! I'll definitely give it a shot. Appreciate the encouragement! See you soon, bye!" (Calvin's Tokyo plans in the Tokyo trip section of /memories/calvin.md; Dave's ramen/Tokyo-food interest in ## Japan) [S24T17][S24T18][S24T19][S24T20][S24T21][S24T22][S24T23].

Calvin: Hey Dave, been a few days, so I wanted to let you in on some cool news.  I just got a new car and it's amazing! Finally owning a luxury car was a dream come true and I'm so stoked.
[S2T1] (dia_id: D2:1)

Dave: Woohoo, Calvin! Congrats on the new car! How's it driving?
[S2T2] (dia_id: D2:2)

Calvin: Nice car! It's an amazing ride - super smooth and real powerful. Like a rockstar behind the wheel! Thanks, man!
[S2T3] (dia_id: D2:3)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Owning something like this must feel amazing. Is this your first one? Show me a pic! What's it called?
[S2T4] (dia_id: D2:4)

Calvin: Woohoo! I finally got myself this beauty. Here's a pic from yesterday when I took it for a ride. Can't believe I'm actually driving it. Definitely what I deserve after all this hard work. Every time I step in, it's like an adrenaline rush!
[Image caption: a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road]
[S2T5] (dia_id: D2:5)

Dave: Calvin, that car looks awesome! You must feel amazing every time you get inside! You deserved it - congrats buddy!
[S2T6] (dia_id: D2:6)

Calvin: Woah, I'm on cloud nine! Hard work pays off. What's up with you, Dave?
[S2T7] (dia_id: D2:7)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Doing good. Last weekend, I went to a music festival in Boston - it was awesome! So many cool bands playing and the atmosphere was electric. I love music, it reminded me why I love it. Here's a pic, take a look.
[Image caption: a photo of a large crowd of people at a concert]
